# Tasks: Saga-Sales E-Commerce Microservices

*Phase 2 Output — Generated by spec-kit tasks command*
*Group 1 of 3 | Status: In Progress*

## Parallel Task Groups

### [P] Group A — Identity & Tenant Infrastructure

- [P] P01: Create Tenant entity + migrations → Catalog Service database
- [P] P02: Create User entity + authentication endpoints (login/register)
- [P] P03: Configure JWT generation with tenant claim propagation middleware
- [P] P04: Implement IdentityService startup (config, DI, OpenAPI, health checks)
- [ ] P05: Seed test tenant for development verification

### [P] Group B — Catalog Domain (Products & Categories)

- [P] P11: Create Product entity, repository, domain event (CatalogProductCreatedEvent)
- [P] P12: Create Category entity with self-referencing hierarchy
- [P] P13: Implement Product CRUD handlers (MediatR commands)
- [P] P14: Implement product listing queries with category filter + pagination
- [P] P15: Configure RabbitMQ publisher for product events
- [P] P16: Write unit tests for product validation rules

### [P] Group C — Sales Domain (Orders & Order Items)

- [P] P21: Create Order aggregate root with status transitions
- [P] P22: Create OrderItem aggregate with ProductSnapshot denormalization
- [P] P23: Implement order creation command with atomic stock deduction
- [P] P24: Implement order status update commands (enforce transitions)
- [P] P25: Subscribe to CatalogProductCreatedEvent → preload product data
- [P] P26: Write concurrency tests for concurrent order placement

### [P] Group D — Payment Integration

- [P] P31: Create Payment entity with gateway response serialization
- [P] P32: Implement payment creation handler with Stripe SDK integration
- [P] P33: Implement Stripe webhook endpoint with signature verification
- [P] P34: Implement refund command and handler
- [P] P35: Configure PayPal SDK initialization stub (conditional)

### [P] Group E — Customer Management

- [P] P41: Create Customer + Address entities
- [P] P42: Implement customer CRUD with FluentValidation rules
- [P] P43: Implement search endpoint (by email, phone)
- [P] P44: Integrate customer lookup from Sales orders

### [P] Group F — Blazor WebAssembly Frontend

- [P] P51: Create BlazorApp.razor + App.razor shell with MudBlazor layout
- [P] P52: Implement login page with JWT storage (Blazored.LocalStorage)
- [P] P53: Implement customer management page (CRUD)
- [P] P54: Implement product catalog page with filtering/pagination
- [P] P55: Implement order dashboard page
- [P] P56: Implement analytics dashboard with ChartJs.Blazor
- [P] P57: Wire up API client service consuming all internal APIs through gateway

| Gate | Prerequisites | Decision |
|------|-------------|----------|
| G-01: Core infrastructure builds | P01, P02, P03, P04 | Proceed if all pass |
| G-02: Catalog service functional | P01-P04, P11-P16 | Proceed if CRUD works end-to-end |
| G-03: Sales domain operational | P01-P04, P11-P26 | Proceed if order creation + stock works |
| G-04: Payment pipeline stable | P01-P04, P21-P35 | Proceed if payments flow correctly |

## Convergence Checklist

- [ ] All services build successfully (`dotnet build SagaSales.sln`)
- [ ] docker compose infrastructure up (postgres, rabbitmq, redis, seq)
- [ ] Health checks return healthy across all services
- [ ] End-to-end: login → browse products → place order → pay → analytics visible
- [ ] Multi-tenant isolation verified with two tenants
- [ ] Contract API tests pass against real infrastructure
- [ ] Specification artifacts version-controlled and tracked
